display.purpose: Opening identity and major section statements; normal weight with tight tracking.

headline.purpose: Section introductions and editorial statements; normal weight with tight tracking.

title.purpose: Featured project names and supporting headings.

label.purpose: Dates and compact technical metadata values.

shadows.name: dialog-depth
shadows.purpose: Separates project detail from the page.

motion.name: duration-medium
motion.purpose: Image scale and dialog surface transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes spatial movement while preserving functional state changes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The main route from the introduction into selected work.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:2.75rem; padding:0 1rem; background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-ink); font:500 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:.01em; transition:background-color 180ms var(--ease-out),color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet route or supporting action beside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:2.75rem; padding:0 1rem; background:transparent; color:var(--color-muted); font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:.01em; transition:color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: A compact route bar with a persistent theme control.
components.html: K/OPROJECTS
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; align-items:center; min-height:3.75rem; padding:0 1.25rem; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule); background:var(--color-paper); color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-mark { color:var(--color-ink); font:400 1rem/.95 var(--font-display); letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-nav-link,.ds-nav-toggle { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:0 .75rem; color:var(--color-muted); font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:.01em; transition:color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav-link:hover,.ds-nav-toggle:hover { color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible,.ds-nav-toggle:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Image Caption
components.description: An open project entry pairing a real screenshot with title, caption, and factual metadata.
components.css: .ds-gallery-entry { margin:0; color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-gallery-media { aspect-ratio:16/10; max-height:420px; background:var(--color-paper-deep); transition:transform 280ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-gallery-entry:hover .ds-gallery-media { transform:scale(1.02); } .ds-gallery-entry figcaption { padding-top:1rem; } .ds-gallery-meta { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; color:var(--color-muted); font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-gallery-entry h3 { margin:.25rem 0 0; color:var(--color-ink); font:500 clamp(1.5rem,2.3vw,2rem)/1.25 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-gallery-entry p { margin:.5rem 0 0; max-width:56ch; color:var(--color-muted); font:400 .9375rem/1.55 var(--font-body); }

components.name: Grouped List
components.description: Plain grouped text for education, recognition, and skills.
components.css: .ds-list { color:var(--color-ink); } .ds-list h3 { margin:0; padding:1rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule); color:var(--color-ink); font:500 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-list p { margin:0; padding:1.25rem 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-rule-soft); } .ds-list strong { color:var(--color-ink); font:500 .9375rem/1.55 var(--font-body); } .ds-list span { color:var(--color-muted); font:400 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing:.06em; }

components.name: Theme Control
components.description: A visible, keyboard-accessible control for the shared light and dark preference.
components.css: .ds-theme { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; padding:0 .75rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule); border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:transparent; color:var(--color-muted); font:500 .75rem/1.45 var(--font-body); letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; transition:border-color 180ms var(--ease-out),color 180ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-theme:hover { border-color:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent); } .ds-theme:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio gives each project the attention of a carefully edited product catalogue: a real interface leads, while concise context explains the engineering judgment behind it. The visual language is Swiss-inspired and precise, using alignment, proportion, and whitespace to make the work easy to inspect. The opening composition follows the calm, open image-and-caption rhythm visible in Helena Zhang's homepage (https://www.helenazhang.com/). The experience is calm and tactile. Cool paper surfaces in light mode and deep blue-black surfaces in dark mode hold full-color project imagery; a single blue accent marks action, focus, and selected state. The masthead and footer stay quiet so the work remains the visual center. Identity is modest, the introduction stands on its own before selected work, and credentials remain plain grouped lists.
keyCharacteristics: Real project screenshots presented as open image-and-caption entries.
Large aligned grids with generous whitespace and deliberate asymmetry.
One blue accent reserved for action, focus, and state.
Geist for editorial reading, with IBM Plex Mono for dates and technical metadata.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve blue for an action, focus ring, selected state, or link so its meaning stays clear.

rules.name: The Metadata Type Rule
rules.body: Use mono only when text records a date, technical measure, or compact metadata value; keep navigation and narrative copy in Geist.

dos: Do let real project screenshots and authored descriptions carry the proof.
Do use open image-and-caption entries, generous whitespace, and full-color imagery to establish hierarchy.
Do keep light and dark themes structurally consistent while adapting surface and accent values.
Do preserve visible focus, keyboard access, Escape dismissal, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't invent project outcomes, benchmarks, testimonials, or customer claims.
Don't dilute the blue accent with competing decorative colors or persistent glow effects.
Don't replace authored project imagery with generic gradients or stock scenes.
Don't use mono for narrative body copy or motion that gates content.
